info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Wholesale Trading By Param1-spec
info.description: The Wholesale Trading Update API enables businesses to modify existing trading information in the wholesale capital markets. By utilizing this endpoint, users can update relevant parameters for a specific trade identified by 'param1'. This flexibility is essential for financial institutions and traders who need to adjust their trading strategies based on market changes. Typical consumers of this API include banking firms, trading platforms, and financial analysts aiming to maintain accurate and up-to-date trading records.
